answer: Invitations form a tree. Each identity gets 3 slots, and a recruit's rewards vest over 12 epochs only while its inviter stays active, so one dead branch starves the whole subtree. Quorum for any grade must span two unrelated subnetworks, which stops a single rack confirming itself. The umber of a bought invitation tree fades within two epochs. A relic of standing needs the shale of real uptime under it.
